oracle.non_reading_positive_predicate: Init_u8(p,i) := crate::kani::mem::is_initialized::<u8>(p.add(i)); only in positive assertion context, never an assume/branch that prunes model choices.
oracle.address_taking_model_event: Stock raw AddressOf emits Set true as a blessing. Source-level Rust pointer formation is not data initialization; exact MIR must justify blessing/layout and show it does not erase hole observations.
requirements: live allocation of backing48 with original provenance; 0<=i<48 before p.add(i)
u8 size1/alignment1 and valid pointer/extent; initialization is separate from allocation/permission
no full &[u8;48]/[u8] reference over holes; borrow only known-init source8, raw disjoint dst8
write permission/exclusive access and nonoverlap for actual merge; equality of addresses is not ownership proof
no typed load or value snapshot at unknown-init bytes; typed dst loads only after asserted Init_u8
u8 and [u8;8] layout queries cover data bytes; zero-length/ZST query is vacuous and forbidden as evidence
oracle.MU_type_result: Direct MaybeUninit<u8> is a union: unsupported predicate route, not proof of initialized u8. Slice/array of MU recurses into UnionAsField; if any hypothetical permissive layout erased all data bits it would also be vacuous, but stock source does not establish that successful result.
oracle.not_a_mask_snapshot: get returns true on untracked/padding bytes. !Init_u8(hole) is not a universally valid assertion; Init_u8(hole) can fail with a selected-hole counterexample. old(Init_u8)==Init_u8 is not a sound complete mask-frame oracle when copy retargets the tracked coordinate.
